newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest Jan-July runoff forecast at 130 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest Jan-July runoff forecast at 130 pct.

text.p: Runoff for January to July on the Columbia River at The Dalles dam in Oregon is now forecast to reach 130 percent of average levels, the Northwest River Forecast Center in Portland said Thursday.
The agency's "early bird" runoff forecast in late December assessed runoff at 113 percent of normal or 120 million acre feet (maf).
But the forecast was raised to 138 maf after recent heavy storms, the center said.
Last year, runoff totaled 139.3 maf, or 132 percent of average levels for the 1961-1990 period.
The Dalles, the second-to-last hydroelectric project on the Columbia, is generally used as the benchmark for regional runoff due to its location and long historical record.
